items.claim: Lukey quits or looks for a way out when he faces adversity or the fight gets extended.
items.quote: it kind of looks like in a lot of these fights he just doesn't want to be in there when the fight gets extended when things get tough and he'll kind of just pull guard and look for a way out.

items.claim: Treyton Gore has incredible durability and a phenomenal chin based on the damage he took against Marco Tulio.
items.quote: he has low volume but he's super durable. I mean the amount of damage he took against Marco Tolio was was incredible. You the guy showed a phenomenal chin.

items.claim: Treyton Gore has one of the best guillotines in the game, with all three of his UFC wins coming by guillotine.
items.quote: he has probably one of the best freaking guillotines in the game. This guy has three wins in the UFC, all come by guillotine.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is the better striker, will have a height advantage, and a big reach advantage of around seven inches.
items.quote: I think he's the better striker. He's going to have a height advantage. He's going to have a big reach advantage of like seven inches.

items.claim: Raphael Tobias landed only about 15 strikes across 15 minutes in his UFC debut against Dulatbek Tursynbek uulu (referred to as Dr. Nurg).
items.quote: Tobias looked awful in his debut against Nurg. I'm talking awful. I'm talking like William Knight performance type awful where he landed like 15 strikes across 15 minutes.

items.claim: Charles Johnson's durability is starting to decline as he has been getting hurt badly in recent fights.
items.quote: I think the chin is starting to go a little bit for Charles Johnson. He got hurt very badly against Alex Perez. He got hurt very badly against Timarrov

items.claim: Jose Ochoa is extremely aggressive on the feet and possesses a ton of power.
items.quote: Jose Ooa, this guy's a madman. This guy is extremely aggressive on the feet. He has a ton of power

items.claim: Charles Johnson does not wrestle at all.
items.quote: Charles Johnson, it's just not his game. Charles Johnson does not wrestle at all.

items.claim: Neil Magny's defensive grappling leaves a lot to be desired and he has been submitted roughly seven times.
items.quote: Neil Magny whose defensive grappling leaves a lot to be desired. I mean, Neil Magny's been submitted like seven times
